firac.facts: Major General S.G. Vombatkere filed a writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India challenging a notification issued by the Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare, Ministry of Defence. The notification, dated 03.03.2017, was published in the Gazette of India and was related to the petitioner's pension. The court heard the preliminary hearing and considered the submission from the respondents that the notification had been withdrawn by a subsequent notification dated 04.03.2020.
issues: Whether the writ petition survives for consideration after the challenged notification was withdrawn by a subsequent notification dated 04.03.2020.
rules: Article 226 of the Constitution of India
firac.holding: The court held that the writ petition does not survive for consideration as the challenged notification was withdrawn by a subsequent notification dated 04.03.2020. The petition was accordingly dismissed, but the petitioner was given the option to revive the petition if the submission regarding the withdrawal was found incorrect.
firac.ratio_decidendi: A writ petition challenging a government notification does not survive if the notification has been withdrawn by a subsequent valid notification, thereby rendering the original petition moot.
